text:
iris: FYI p99 on the latency panel for /v1/generate spiked ~150ms in eu-central after we flipped the spillover rule at 15:10. p50 stable, p95 small uptick. Only small payloads (<30 tokens).
noel: looking now. The "combined" (all-variants) series jumps but variant traces point to rdw-gpt-q4_micro.
sasha: timeline: spillover ramped 0->35% at 15:11. deploy-bot: rollout spillover-canary id=spill-2026-03-26T15:11 -> 35% completed.
iris: ran a raw check: ```curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://telemetry.internal/api/raw?from=6195550000&to=6195552000&route=/v1/generate&env=eu-central" | jq .lat_ms```
noel: raw counts for window: q4_micro=275, q3_std=6000. Rollup metadata has tdigest: true but merged_count: null.
telemetry-bot: rollup-emitter v3.2 note: merged_tdigests=true, merged_count=null.
sasha: hypothesis A: tdigest sketches merged without sample-weighting, so a small sketch with a heavy tail pulls blended p99. Hypothesis B: microbatch kernel has a batch_fill wait and fallback pool queueing magnifies tail. Both plausible.
noel: I exported raw p99 by variant+policy and it matches: q4_micro/spillover p99 elevated; q3/strict stable. So blended misleads operators.
iris: console-ux - can we show "how this p99 was computed" on the panel? i.e. provenance: raw-samples vs merged-sketches (weighted/unweighted) + sample counts.
console-ux: yes. will add a provenance pill + per-series sample counts on hover. quick patch target EOD.
noel: infra-bot shows fallback pool avg_queue_depth=7.5 at peak; worker_count=5. batch_fill_wait p99=52ms.
infra-bot: autoscaler: fallback-eu did not scale (min=5). current avg_queue_depth=7.5.
sasha: operationally we should (1) reduce spillover to 5% immediately; (2) either scale fallback pool or lower microbatch timeout; (3) fix telemetry merge logic.
iris: lowering to 5% now. deploy-bot: spillover-canary scaled to 5% at 15:18.
noel: I'll open telemetry PR to emit merged_count and switch to a weighted tdigest merge. Also add unit tests for unequal-count merges.
sasha: if telemetry change is non-trivial, the quick UX change + splitting the dashboard by routing_policy should be our interim defense.
console-ux: interim default will show split-by-policy lines for 24h and surface a tooltip: "Blended percentiles may reflect merged sketches; click to split by variant/policy."
infra-bot: requested +2 workers to fallback-eu (worker_count -> 7). queue depth dropped to 1.9 within 2 minutes. batch_fill_wait p99 down to 18ms.
sasha: filing INC-1600 (latency: p99 spike during spillover canary). tagging @sre-oncall.
telemetry-bot: PR #1024 opened: "tdigest: emit merged_count + weighted merge + metadata flag". cc @noel @iris for review.
noel: will review; adding tests to ensure weighted merge produces sample-weighted p99 equivalent to raw-samples.
iris: action items summarized: 1) infra -> scale + fallback tuning (done); 2) deploy -> canary back to 5% (done); 3) telemetry -> PR + tests (#1024); 4) console-ux -> provenance pill + default split (ETA EOD); 5) ops -> annotate dashboard with canary timeline and a short note about blended percentile caveat.
sre-oncall: once telemetry change lands, reprocess recent rollups to populate merged_count so provenance UI can be backfilled. Also add an alert if blended p99 deviates >50ms from sample-weighted baseline.
isra: thanks all — follow-up postmortem to capture the multi-factor cause (merge artifact + batching wait + rollout cadence) and document rollout guidance. :memo:
